newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-PLAYERS' CHAMPIONSHIP THIRD ROUND SCORES.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PLAYERS' CHAMPIONSHIP THIRD ROUND SCORES.

text.p: Leading third round scores in the 750,000 rand ($161,000) Players' championship at the par-72 Durban Country Club on Saturday (South African unless stated): 208 Andre Cruse 70 66 72 209 Warren Schutte 69 71 69, Nico van Rensburg 67 69 73 210 Richard Kaplan 66 70 74, Trevor Dodds (Namibia) 73 65 72 211 Michael Green 70 66 75 212 Andrew McLardy 73 68 71, Tom Gillis (U.S.) 71 70 71, Wayne Bradley 70 70 72, Jeff Hawkes 68 67 77
